_comment: Topic seed data per (exam-slug)/(subject-slug). frequencyScore is a 0-100 hint for the AI generator and the heatmap weighting — initial values are best-guess from past-paper distribution; will be tuned from real attempt data post-launch. Topic descriptions are short (1-2 sentences) so a generator/reviewer can confirm the slug means what they think it means. Sprint 6 expanded JAMB to all 9 active subjects and seeded WAEC + NECO core subjects (English / Math / Biology / Chemistry / Physics) with 8-12 topics each. The remaining WAEC + NECO subjects (Lit / Govt / Econ / Geo / History / CRK / Agric) currently have empty topic lists — admin should populate via /admin/topics or the bulk-generate pipeline once the first round of Math/English questions are reviewed.
